valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E on the ordinary share, converted to the USD ADR. FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS (the year an investor at the Nov 2027 target date prices) times a P/E, in pence, then converted. 1 ADR = 1 ordinary share (ratio 1:1). FX: GBP/USD about 1.32 (intraday 2026-11-13 per Trading Economics; the exact close was not found). Anchor: FY2025 adjusted diluted EPS 352.1p reported (352.8p Canada-adjusted constant currency); FY2026 guided towards the middle of 5-8% constant-currency growth (H1 2026 167.7p) less a 2-3% translational FX headwind, so about +4% reported, about 366p. FY2027 EPS is my assumption: about +6% on that, from low-single-digit revenue growth, mid-single-digit profit growth, GBP1.3bn buyback and lower finance costs. Targets are price only.

bear.driver: Cigarette volumes fall faster than the guided c.2.5% and new-category growth slows; EPS growth only about +1.5% and the multiple stays near today's

base.driver: FY2026 lands mid-guidance, H2-weighted profit delivers, buyback and deleveraging support mid-single-digit EPS growth

bull.driver: New categories (Velo, Glo, Vuse) scale with US share gains, leverage reaches 2.0x and the discount to global staples narrows

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of 388p the $61.89 close (about GBP 46.9) implies 12.1x; the analyst-weighted target (no 12-month-documented targets, so none weighted) is not available, the Goldman $74 would imply about 14.4x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by about $5.12 (8.3 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted diluted EPS growth at constant currency versus the middle of 5-8%, plus H2 adjusted operating profit delivery
valuation.next_disclosure: FY2026 preliminary results, expected February 2027 (date not confirmed)

analyst_notes: Only three named BTI calls were found in the last three months, all Buy: Goldman raised its target to $74 from $68.72 on 2026-11-02, Morgan Stanley to $68.10 from $66.70 on 2026-09-07, and BofA reiterated Buy. Horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target. Goldman's $74 versus my $66.6 base is about 1.3 turns of P/E (or about 30p of FY2027 EPS at 13x). Coverage here is thin and GBP-based LSE targets are not included.
